info.title: EMASS Toolkit API
info.description: EMASS Toolkit backend API. All responses use the envelope `{ success, statusCode, message, data? }`.

tags.name: Auth
tags.description: Signup with an emailed code, MFA for staff, rotating refresh tokens

tags.name: Products
tags.description: Active products (seeded; admin CRUD comes later)

tags.name: Releases
tags.description: Release management for staff. Drafts are changed only by the DEV who created them; ADMIN reviews, publishes and rolls back.

get.summary: Issue an image captcha (cookie carries the expected answer)

post.summary: Signup step 1: the form. Competitor domains are blocked; otherwise a 6-digit code is emailed. Signing up again before finishing resumes with a new code

403.description: Domain not accepted

post.summary: Signup step 2: check the emailed code without using it up (unknown or finished accounts get OTP_INVALID)

400.description: Validation failed, or a bad code

post.summary: Signup step 3: use the code and set the password. A company address becomes ACTIVE and is signed in (cookies); a free-mail address waits for admin approval

400.description: Validation failed, or a bad code

403.description: Domain not accepted

post.summary: Sign in — customers get tokens; DEV/ADMIN get { mfaRequired: true } and an emailed OTP

200.description: Logged in, or MFA challenge issued

403.description: Account not active or blocked

post.summary: Resend an MFA login OTP (DEV/ADMIN) or a signup code (SIGNUP_VERIFY: always 200, sent only for an unfinished signup)

403.description: Not allowed

post.summary: Verify an MFA login OTP (DEV/ADMIN); sets the session cookies

403.description: Not allowed

post.summary: Email a 30-minute, single-use reset link. Always the same 200, whether or not the email has an account; at most one email a minute per account

200.description: If an account exists for that email, we've sent a reset link

post.summary: Check the token from a reset link without using it up; returns the account's email
Set a new password with the token from a reset link; uses the link up and signs out every session

200.description: Password updated. Sign in with your new password

400.description: Invalid, used or expired link, or the current password

post.summary: Rotate the refresh-token cookie and set a new access-token cookie (cookies only; one call in flight per device)

401.description: Missing, invalid, expired or reused refresh token

post.summary: Revoke the refresh-token cookie and clear it

post.description: Answers 202 at once; poll publish-status. A second call while the job runs returns the same job. All-or-nothing: a failed copy or final check leaves the database unchanged and removes the copies.

get.description: job is null when none is known (never started, or lost in a server restart); status tells the two apart. Failed jobs carry COPY_FAILED, COPY_TIMEOUT, SOURCE_NOT_FOUND, RELEASE_LOCKED, RELEASE_CHANGED, VERSION_NOT_NEWER or PUBLISH_FAILED.
